question: Which Indian para-archer became the first in the sport to receive the Padma Shri after winning gold at the 2024 Paris Paralympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harvinder Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Harvinder Singh** is an Indian para-archer who created history by becoming the first para-archer to receive the prestigious Padma Shri award.
 
• He clinched a historic **gold medal at the 2024 Paris Paralympics**, marking a significant achievement for Indian sports.
